provenance.paper_title: Affordance RAG: Hierarchical Multimodal Retrieval With Affordance-Aware Embodied Memory for Mobile Manipulation

representation_paths.memory_component: Target object candidates and receptacle candidates

evidence.section: Full paper: A. Affordance-Aware Embodied Memory
evidence.paraphrase: The robot builds Affordance Mem during pre-exploration from collected images.; SEEM-style segmentation produces object masks; VLMs produce descriptions; embeddings are stored for multimodal retrieval.; Agglomerative clustering builds higher-level region nodes and summaries, making the memory hierarchical rather than a flat image bank.. graph query/traversal over the memory conditioned on the current goal.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): The image/affordance store is constructed before downstream queries and only retrieved at inference; top-k selection is not eviction. No persistent inference-time T2 update or deployment-feedback policy evolution was found.
